action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check processes
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ps aux | grep node | grep -v grep | wc -l")
print("Node processes:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check PM2
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 list")
print("\n=== PM2 ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Check error log
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -20 /var/log/areloria/error-0.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No error log'")
print("\n=== Error Log ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
